name: voice
description: Spoken notifications for Claude Code: hear when Claude finishes a task or needs your attention, with a one-line summary Claude writes itself. Local text-to-speech with Piper, no API keys.

nombre.title: What should it call you?
nombre.description: The name each notification starts with, e.g. "Gastón, terminé en tienda online". Leave empty to use the first name of your system account (none on Windows); a dash (-) says no name.
